_noteE_wall: WALL-SLAM CURATED (loop 472, user request). The previous pass deliberately omitted WallHitDamage as 'too positional/conditional to assume it lands' - a conservative floor, and the right call when the only choice was to include it always or never. The M25/M28 condition mechanism removes that dilemma: HitsWall is UserAssumed and defaults UNMET, so the floor is unchanged and the user ticks a box when the slam actually happened. Evidence (user-supplied Korean wiki text, reconciled against the BIN this session): base '기본 최대 피해' 80/115/150/185/220 (+1.0 bonus AD)(+1.0 AP) = calc Damage = MaxBaseDamage[1..5] + 1.0/1.0 coefficients; wall '지형 충돌 추가 피해' 140/215/290/365/440 (+2.4 bonus AD)(+2.4 AP) = calc WallHitDamage = WallHitBaseDamage[1..5] + 2.4/2.4. The Korean text says 추가 (ADDITIONAL), so it is a second hit on top of the base rather than a replacement - hence the K'Sante R shape: no calc at all, because the UNMET state is 'this did not happen', not 'a smaller number'. CHARGE IS NOT CURATED and cannot be from this BIN: the wiki says damage is proportional to charge time, but BriarE exposes only MaxBaseDamage with no minimum-charge calc, so there is no floor to interpolate from and the curated value stays the fully-charged one (which is also what the wall bonus requires). The in-game requirement that the scream be fully charged before it knocks back is therefore implicit in both hits.
